station.area: A1 Rabat-Casablanca, El Mansouria / after Bouznika toll, direction Casablanca

evidence.claim: Shell identifies Al Jazira on the A1 direction Casablanca after the Bouznika toll and explicitly states that Shell Recharge fast charging is offered at the site.

Vivo Energy Maroc describes Shell Al Jazira as its new-generation Shell service station and the Shell Recharge installation as the first fast-charging infrastructure under the Shell brand in the Vivo Energy network in Africa. This establishes Vivo Energy Maroc as the project/site operator context but does not explicitly name the EV charging technical CPO/backend operator.
Shell states that Shell Recharge public locations are discoverable in the Shell App. No public Morocco-specific station payload or live status endpoint was validated in this investigation.

Drivers Life reports five charging bays at Al Jazira: four at 120 kW and one at 22 kW, and says charging was offered free at the time of its report. Treat connector/power and free tariff as secondary candidates pending native/current corroboration.
EVPlug independently describes Shell Recharge / Vivo Energy charging in Morocco as free, but explicitly as secondary corroboration rather than a live/native tariff feed.

A public mirror of a partner-station list identifies VIVO ENERGY MAROC (SHELL) STATION EL JAZIRA, code 1333138, at 33.779558,-7.232679. Coordinates are a high-confidence candidate but the mirror is not treated as charging-network authority.

modeling.cpo_operator: unresolved until a direct charging-operator source explicitly establishes Vivo Energy Maroc or another technical CPO
modeling.tariff_channel: unresolved; do not convert secondary free reports into a direct Shell tariff
modeling.status_source: unresolved; no validated public live-status endpoint

production_recommendation.reason: Official existence/access-network evidence is strong, but exact EV charging CPO attribution, native tariff and live status endpoint are not yet directly validated. Keep station as V9 diagnostic/static candidate and do not publish a free direct tariff by default.
